page.layout: One page: a title page, centred, printed upside down on the scan. Large title at the top, smaller lines below, a short group of lines lower down, and a library stamp in the middle, which is not transcribed. No running head, page number or margin text.
page.notes: The page is printed upside down, so the lines read inverted and most of them cannot be spelled out at this scan resolution. Only the large word at the top is a probable reading ("DEFENSA", marked [?]). The lower lines are capitals in small type and are also unreadable. The round stamp in the middle of the page is a library stamp and was left out.
